blocks.content: When an integer is passed, we can find the numbers that come before and after the given number by subtracting and adding 1 respectively.
The following steps can be used to solve this problem:

items: Calculate before by subtracting 1 from the passed number.
Calculate after by adding 1 to the passed number.
Return the tuple as (before, passed number, after)
